# The timing keys' message above the hotbar, fix/time125 (1.21.11, the demo song). The timing keys start with no key,
# so the script puts them on . and , with the test hook's bind (commit 6d4b02e5, the commit before the fix: compare
# against that, main has no bind and would show no message at all). Each shot, the branch against 6d4b02e5:
# - time125-en-late: "Timing for this song: +0.10 s" above the hotbar, the same on both.
# - time125-he-late: the same message in Hebrew after a second press. On the branch the number reads "+0.20 s" (plus on
#   the left, "s" on the right) to the left of the colon and the Hebrew words. On 6d4b02e5 it reads "s 0.20+": the "s"
#   at the far left and the plus on the right of the number.
# - time125-he-early: four presses of Lyrics are early. Branch "-0.20 s", 6d4b02e5 "s 0.20-".
# - time125-he-zero: two presses of Lyrics are late, back to no timing for the song. Branch "0 s", 6d4b02e5 "s 0".
# Run it, and with -f mod_ref=6d4b02e5 to compare with the old Hebrew text (the script comes from --ref):
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/time125 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/time125.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/time125 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=6d4b02e5 -f script=.github/checks/time125.txt

cmd time set noon
cmd weather clear
look 0 -20
sleep 6
bind skylyrics.lyrics_late period
bind skylyrics.lyrics_early comma
sleep 1
hold skylyrics.lyrics_late 60
sleep 0.6
shot time125-en-late

lang he_il
sleep 15
hold skylyrics.lyrics_late 60
sleep 0.6
shot time125-he-late
hold skylyrics.lyrics_early 60
sleep 0.3
hold skylyrics.lyrics_early 60
sleep 0.3
hold skylyrics.lyrics_early 60
sleep 0.3
hold skylyrics.lyrics_early 60
sleep 0.6
shot time125-he-early
hold skylyrics.lyrics_late 60
sleep 0.3
hold skylyrics.lyrics_late 60
sleep 0.6
shot time125-he-zero

lang en_us
sleep 15
